serialize_protobuf_message_to_dict: convert a protobuf message to a JSON-compatible dictionary using proto3 JSON spec
parse_json_dict_to_protobuf_message: parse a JSON dictionary into a protobuf message instance from a message class
serialize_with_preserved_field_names: serialize a protobuf message to dict preserving original proto field names instead of camelCase
parse_with_unknown_field_tolerance: parse a JSON dict into a protobuf message ignoring unknown fields without raising errors
serialize_with_integer_enums: serialize a protobuf message to dict using integer values instead of enum names
